user.title: Set up water softener
user.description: Counts regenerations via the water meter and tracks the salt stock. A regeneration is detected when more water than the threshold is used within the time window.

data_description.water_entity: Sensor with the cumulative reading in litres or m³ (e.g. from the Energy dashboard).
data_description.capacity_kg: How many kilograms of salt fit into the brine tank?
data_description.per_regen_kg: How many kilograms of salt does one regeneration use?
data_description.initial_stock_kg: Optional. Leave empty if the tank is full right now.
data_description.threshold_l: A regeneration counts if more than this amount of water is used within the time window.
data_description.window_start_hour: Start of the time window in which the regeneration takes place (default 2 am).
data_description.window_end_hour: End of the time window (default 3 am). Must be after the start.
data_description.warn_remaining: From this calculated remaining stock on, a notice is shown until the refill is confirmed.

error.window_invalid: The end of the time window must be after its start.
error.per_regen_too_large: Salt per regeneration must not exceed the tank capacity.
error.stock_too_large: The current salt stock must not exceed the tank capacity.

error.window_invalid: The end of the time window must be after its start.
error.per_regen_too_large: Salt per regeneration must not exceed the tank capacity.
error.stock_too_large: The current salt stock must not exceed the tank capacity.

refill.name: Salt refilled
refill.description: Confirms that salt was refilled. The amount in kg is required and is added to the stock (at most up to full). The notice ends once the stock is above the warning threshold again.

config_entry.name: Water softener
config_entry.description: Only needed if several softeners are set up.

kg.name: Amount refilled
kg.description: Amount in kg that was added.

set_salt_stock.name: Set salt stock
set_salt_stock.description: Sets the calculated salt stock to a specific value (e.g. after checking the tank).

config_entry.name: Water softener
config_entry.description: Only needed if several softeners are set up.

add_regeneration.name: Add regeneration
add_regeneration.description: Manually adds a regeneration that was not detected (counter and salt stock are adjusted).

config_entry.name: Water softener
config_entry.description: Only needed if several softeners are set up.

set_last_regeneration.name: Set last regeneration
set_last_regeneration.description: Sets the time of the last regeneration (e.g. from the softener's display). Determines “Next regeneration at the latest” and the “Regeneration overdue” notice. Counters and salt stock stay unchanged.

config_entry.name: Water softener
config_entry.description: Only needed if several softeners are set up.

datetime.name: Time
datetime.description: Date and time of the last regeneration (not in the future).

set_regenerations_since_refill.name: Set regenerations since refill
set_regenerations_since_refill.description: Sets the known regenerations since the tank was last filled up. The salt stock is calculated from it: tank capacity minus count × salt used per regeneration.

config_entry.name: Water softener
config_entry.description: Only needed if several softeners are set up.

count.name: Count
count.description: Regenerations since the tank was last filled up.
